text: 1.Hold a non-Chinese passport and pass the required health check for visa holders in China . 2.Hold a recognized bachelor degree or above, or equivalent. 3.Have obtained a minimum score of 550 points or above for Old TOEFL, 80 points or above for New TOEFL, grade 6.0 or above for IELTS, or on presentation of a certificate from some other approved test of English proficiency. Native English speakers and applicants whose teaching language during undergraduate studies is English are exempt from this requirement. Other candidates whose university courses were taught in English will be considered on a case by case basis. 4.The ability to demonstrate relevant professional experience will be given individual consideration.
